methodology.openapiOrder: AB, BA, then one bounded AB confirmation
methodology.sourceMetric: loader probe + AST traversal probe + complete NestJS analyzer + contract comparison
methodology.warmMeaning: subsequent repetitions in one Node process; source probe loader cached, complete analyzer loads its own project
methodology.openapiPair1: Observed major variation across parse/resolve/normalize (1000-op warm 124.560..1305.671ms, 10000-op warm 1131.288..4002.482ms). Preserve all samples and all-observed statistics; do not attribute that difference to the patch. Pairs 2 and 3 are reported separately for the reproducible comparison.
methodology.comparisonLimits: One local macOS arm64 host; synthetic fixtures; no production latency or hosted performance baseline claim.

initial.safety: Candidate write index and symbol facts are scoped to one projectSources identity and published after complete traversal. Pointer cache is scoped to one resolver call and document identity. Cancellation/deadline, dynamic/unknown behavior, reference-context checks, depth/node accounting and realpath boundaries remain in the canonical path.

methodology.sourceMetric: cached loader probe + AST traversal probe + complete fresh NestJS analyzer + authentication count check + contract comparison
methodology.confirmation: After the initial final comparison, routes-100 had a 2.93% mean increase and OpenAPI showed large tail variability. Added one bounded AB/BA confirmation for those two commands. All original and confirmation samples are included: four processes / twenty warm samples per phase for routes-100 and all six OpenAPI workloads.
methodology.exclusions: First sample of each process only. All final paired warm samples are included.
methodology.limits: One local macOS arm64 host, fixed synthetic input, no concurrent build/test/benchmark. Sample variability is reported; this is not a production SLA or population tail estimate.
methodology.fixture: Nine emitted routes plus one dynamic operation per controller. Every odd controller in the three added patterns has nine unknown auth routes; the even controllers keep high-confidence guards.
methodology.diagnosticBudget: Benchmark-only maxDiagnostics=10000 and timeoutMs=60000 on both sides; production defaults unchanged.
methodology.memory: heap deltas only, not total or peak memory

incompleteAttempt.reason: The 500-controller assignment-heavy fixture reached the product default 1000 diagnostic limit. Preserve the rejected run; final measurements use the same benchmark-only 10000 diagnostic budget on both sides.
incompleteAttempt.rawFileNaming: Original historical job ids start with paired-. Their saved raw JSON/stderr filenames use attempt1- instead, so they cannot be confused with the final paired-* files.

verification.specialistReview: ALLOW, no acceptance/security findings; scoped final review receipt is local evidence

full.fixtureEnvironment: EDGE_ADMIN_TOKEN set to the README documented dummy; no production secret

setupFailures: Initial fixture assertions assumed ten emitted routes instead of nine, and a namespace-call fixture did not exercise the intended bare namespace branch. Corrected before final measurement.
Initial shared-reference hop test did not exhaust its node budget. Replaced with a sixteen-hop chain reused by forty operations; baseline and candidate both pass the corrected rejection check.
Initial full CI lacked the required EDGE_ADMIN_TOKEN fixture and stopped at build. Preserved the failure and reran with the README documented dummy value only in the local validation process.
